thread:
Priya (AE): FYI ACME POC hitting 403s on staging when calling /v1/generate. Started after we issued them the scoped service key this morning.

Priya (AE): curl example they used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_abc123" -H "x-redwood-org: acme-prod" -d '{"input":"hello"}'```

Marco (Solutions): 403 usually means the token's tenant/org claim doesn't include that org/project. Did you create a project-scoped key vs org-scoped?

Priya (AE): They said the key came from the trial console under our partner org; I'm not 100% sure which scope was selected. Error they pasted: ```{"error":"access_denied","message":"token tenant_id mismatch: expected 67890 got 0","status":403}```

Sam (DevEx): That error string is our runtime rejecting a token with no tenant claim. Trial keys are single-tenant and bound to the trial org. For POCs we usually generate a service key with the org and project claim. Ask them to use the 'Service key (org+project)' we created in the partner console.

Nina (Infra): Also note we rotated some signing keys at 08:12 UTC. If they cached a bearer token they might be presenting a JWT issued with the old key which now fails validation. Recommend generating a fresh key and redoing the client auth.

Priya (AE): They also reported intermittent 429s during load tests. Can we confirm rate limit buckets for trial vs partner accounts?

TJ (Sales Eng): Trial accounts share the shared rate limit pool, so 429s are expected if they blast concurrently. For the enterprise POC we can request a temporary quota bump or recommend a Dedicated trial commit to avoid throttling. I'll coordinate with partnerships for a short-term bump.

Marco (Solutions): Quick debug checklist for them: 1) confirm using the new service key (not the trial UI token) 2) include correct x-redwood-org header or use org-scoped token (prefer token-only) 3) rotate client until tests pass 4) if still 403, paste the full JWT header+payload (redact sig) so we can inspect claims.

Priya (AE): They asked about security questionnaire items while we're triaging: KMS/HSM, SOC2, data residency. Any quick links?

Sam (DevEx): Send them our compliance bundle link: https://redwood.ai/compliance (SOC2 report, PCI/PIMS notes) and mention we support customer-managed keys via KMS for Private deployments. For hosted POC we can offer workspace-level encryption and audit logs.

Priya (AE): Pricing question from buyer: if they move to Dedicated for POC (2x A10 equivalent) what's the short-term cost vs usage-based?

TJ (Sales Eng): I'll pull numbers but rough: Dedicated month-min commitment + predictable per-hour node rate. For POC we can offer a short eval commit (30 days) with a pricing credit applied to first contract if they convert. I'll confirm rates and put an action on billing.

Marco (Solutions): If they can paste the obfuscated JWT (header+payload) we can confirm tenant and scopes quickly. If it's the old-key rotation issue we'll mark as resolved.

Priya (AE): Pasted JWT payload (redacted): ```{"iss":"auth.redwood.ai","sub":"sv-xyz","tenant":"0","scope":"generate:read"}``` — looks like tenant is 0.

Marco (Solutions): Yep that's the problem. Tenant claim is 0 (unbound). They need the org-scoped service key with tenant=67890 or include x-redwood-org header that maps to 67890 (but header mapping only works if token allows it). Recommend we regenerate a service key for ACME, set tenant claim to their org id.

Nina (Infra): I'll spin up a one-off key for them and drop it in the partner console under ACME. Will also check logs for the 08:12 rotation impact.

deploy-bot: Key creation succeeded for svc-acme-2026 (id: sk_svc_renew_197890)

Priya (AE): Switched client to new key and re-ran tests — all green, no 403s, occasional 429 under stress but within expected shared quota.

Priya (AE): Next actions: TJ to confirm pricing credit and short Dedicated eval rates; Nina to follow up on rotation and confirm no other POCs affected; Marco to update the partner-runbook with a short troubleshooting FAQ.

Marco (Solutions): I'll add a new FAQ item: "403 after key rotation or using trial token — verify tenant claim and regenerate service key".

Priya (AE): Thanks everyone — closing this thread unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
